resources.string: Full Foreman on this phone. Your data lives here as real files, with the same atomic writes and rolling backups as the desktop app.
A live window into the Foreman running on your computer. On the desktop, open Preferences → Integrations → Multi-Device Sharing and scan the QR code.
You can change this anytime in Preferences → Integrations.
Scan the QR code from Preferences → Multi-Device Sharing on your desktop
Foreman on this phone is a window into the desktop host at %1$s. Make sure that computer is on and both devices are on the same wifi, then retry.
Use this phone on its own instead
